env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd reject
! logos build .
stderr 'wrong type for method Put'
stderr 'wrong type for method Take'

cd ../app
logos run .
logos eject -o $WORK/ejected

cd $WORK/ejected
exists $UPROOT1273/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1273/bin/go run .

-- app/go.mod --
module example.com/interfaceoption

go 1.27

require example.com/gosink v0.0.0

replace example.com/gosink v0.0.0 => ../gosink

-- app/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/gosink"

type receiver struct {
	nils int
	value int
}

func (r *receiver) Put(p *int?) {
	if p != nil {
		r.value = *p
		return
	}
	r.nils++
}

func main() {
	direct := &receiver{}
	gosink.Exercise(direct)
	if direct.nils != 1 || direct.value != 42 {
		panic("Go calls through the concrete provider lost a nil or nonnil input")
	}

	indirect := &receiver{}
	var optional interface{ Put(*int?) } = indirect
	var embedded interface{ gosink.Sink } = optional
	gosink.Exercise(embedded)
	if indirect.nils != 1 || indirect.value != 42 {
		panic("Go calls through the interface provider lost a nil or nonnil input")
	}
}

-- gosink/go.mod --
module example.com/gosink

go 1.27

-- gosink/sink.go --
package gosink

type Sink interface {
	Put(*int)
}

func Exercise(s Sink) {
	s.Put(nil)
	n := 42
	s.Put(&n)
}

-- reject/go.mod --
module example.com/rejectoption

go 1.27

-- reject/reject.lgo --
package reject

type optional interface{ Put(*int?) }
type strict interface{ Take(*int) }

type receiver struct{}

func (receiver) Put(p *int) {}
func (receiver) Take(p *int?) {}

var _ optional = receiver{}
var _ strict = receiver{}
